title: APS Operator Skill: A topology-agnostic PVD operator procedure for LLM agents
description: A portable, topology-agnostic operating procedure and recipe verification skill for language-model agents controlling physical vapor deposition (PVD) systems over the APS Control Community MCP server across single-chamber batch (Sputter), load-locked multi-source (ADS), and multi-chamber cluster (Cluster) sputtering architectures.
